summary: FINAL retest of FIX 2 (server + admin copy-link magic_url host) plus lightweight regression of FIX 1 (auto-login lands on /vendor/dashboard). ALL PASS. Backend (pytest, 4/4): (1) resend returns working magic_url + non-empty token; (2) complete → cookie set → 410 on reuse → email/password login → forgot-password OK; (3) resend AFTER completion mints a NEW token that also completes; (4) NEW iter-48 test — POST /api/admin/vendors/{id}/resend-onboarding through the preview base URL (no Origin/Referer sent) now returns magic_url that starts with https://admin-sales-report.preview.emergentagent.com AND does NOT contain 'app.cravitoo.com' or 'emergentcf.cloud', with magic_url endswith /auth/magic/{token}. Confirms PUBLIC_APP_URL in backend/.env is being used. Frontend (real preview browser): logged in as master admin, created throwaway vendor, opened resend-onboarding modal, clicked resend-send-btn — resend-magic-link-field value = 'https://admin-sales-report.preview.emergentagent.com/auth/magic/<token>' (FIX 2c PASS). resend-copy-link-btn toggles to 'Copied' after click. Cleared cookies, navigated to the copy-link URL → 'Welcome — set your password' screen renders (not 'Link no longer works'). Set password 'IterPass!2026' → landed on /vendor/dashboard (FIX 1 still holds). Email/password re-login → /vendor/dashboard. Second GET of the same token → 410 (single-use enforced). Cleaned up throwaway vendors (iter-48 + 3 stale TEST_ leftovers from prior iterations) + orphan vendor_magic_links (33) + vendor_email_log (28) rows.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/admin.py: fallback chain (PUBLIC_APP_URL → Origin → X-Forwarded-Host/Proto → Referer → base_url) plus returning `token` in the response is a solid, layered design — resilient to ingress header stripping.

frontend/src/pages/master/Vendors.js:doResend: rebuilding resendLink from window.location.origin + data.token (with data.magic_url fallback) guarantees the admin's copied link always matches the environment they're using — good defensive UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (FIX 2c + FIX 1 + single-use regression all pass end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: Per-test throwaway vendors (TEST_vendor_iter48*, TEST_Iter48*) — cleaned up after test. Also purged 3 stale TEST_ vendors + 33 orphan vendor_magic_links + 28 vendor_email_log rows left by prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both FIX 1 (window.location.replace → /vendor/dashboard) and FIX 2 (server magic_url via PUBLIC_APP_URL + admin UI rebuilds from window.location.origin+token) are fully verified end-to-end through the actual preview k8s ingress. Nothing outstanding on this feature.
rca of the issue: Fully resolved. Iter-47 gap was that the k8s ingress strips the browser Origin header, so backend fell back to request.base_url which reported the internal cluster upstream host. Iter-48 confirms two independent guards close the gap: (a) PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://admin-sales-report.preview.emergentagent.com set in backend/.env so the server-built magic_url is the correct public host regardless of headers; (b) admin UI now rebuilds the copy-link from window.location.origin + the new `token` field returned by the resend response, so the copy-link is always correct even if backend header propagation ever regresses.
